prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the HackerRank problem Triplets.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution incorrectly applies positional constraints while counting triplets, whereas the problem only requires distinct ascending values irrespective of positions.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Misinterpretation of the problem by introducing unnecessary index-based constraints instead of counting distinct value triplets.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Nested loops applying left_bound and right_bound conditions
